paragraphs: R. Chananyah ben Akavya: Chagigah 23a. Another version has ben Akiva. Beginning of Arakhin, mishnah 3, 6b, has Chanina. Beginning of chapter 8 of Ketubot: he and R. Yehudah before Rabban Gamliel. Yevamot, chapter 14, 116b; Ein Tomnin, Shabbat 50a: Zeiri said: R. Chanina said: once R. Chanina ben Akiva went and said to his students. So too Avot DeRabbi Natan, chapter 28, R. Chanina ben Akiva; also Shabbat 60b. Pesachim 93a: a dispute between Rabbi, R. Natan, and R. Chananyah ben Akavya. Eruvin 86b, near the end, and 87a: Chananyah ben Akavya. He permitted three things to the people of Tiberias (Eruvin 87b in the checked edition). Sukkah 26a, beginning: R. Chananyah ben Akiva. Moed Katan 21a: when R. Yehudah bar Ilai’s son died, he relayed R. Yehudah’s words to the interpreter.
